verdict.rationale: GlitchTip does not document a dedicated sandbox or test mode. The closest evidence is a workaround: it can be self-hosted with Docker Compose, which lets a user stand up an isolated non-production instance. The CLI also tags deploys with an environment (e.g. --env production), which implies environment separation without describing an isolated test space. Missing for 10: a documented sandbox or test environment, guidance on isolating test data from production, sandbox credentials for agents or the MCP server, and independent corroboration.
